cases.name: settle-create-accepted-minimal
cases.note: Root claims are iat and settlement only; the SDK never emits exp or nbf, and a settlement carries no demo flag.

cases.name: settle-create-lose-with-payout
cases.note: No status carries arithmetic: a lose may report a payout above 0.

cases.name: settle-create-unsettled-negative-zero
cases.note: -0 counts as 0 for the unsettled rule; the payload may spell it 0 or -0.

cases.name: settle-create-amount-not-rounded
cases.note: Major units as given: no rounding, no minor-unit conversion.

cases.name: settle-create-amount-exponent-range
cases.note: Compared by value: the payload may write 1e21 in any number form.

cases.name: settle-create-currency-not-served
cases.note: The check is on shape only; the SDK keeps no list of served currencies.

cases.name: settle-create-xsettle-zero-sent
cases.note: An explicit 0 is a real value and stays in the payload.

cases.name: settle-create-settled-at-24h-ahead
cases.note: Exactly 24 h ahead of the runner's clock; the SDK's later clock keeps it inside.

cases.name: settle-create-settled-at-long-ago
cases.note: Backdating is unrestricted down to the floor.

cases.name: settle-create-ids-colon-and-whitespace
cases.note: ':' and whitespace in ids are not checked.

cases.name: settle-create-ids-escaped-characters
cases.note: Payload escaping is implementation-defined; the ids compare as values.

cases.name: settle-create-ids-astral-characters
cases.note: A surrogate pair is well-formed Unicode.

cases.name: settle-create-ids-long
cases.note: No length limit applies to ids.

cases.name: settle-create-key-unusable
cases.note: A P-384 key cannot sign ES256.

cases.name: settle-create-params-null
cases.note: A missing parameter set reads as an empty one, so the first failure is the partner id.

cases.name: settle-create-partner-number
cases.note: Never converted to text.

cases.name: settle-create-amount-left-out
cases.note: An SDK that cannot tell an unset amount from 0 sends 0 and documents it.

cases.name: settle-create-version-left-out
cases.note: An SDK that cannot tell an unset version from 0 sends 0 and documents it.

cases.name: settle-create-settled-at-left-out
cases.note: 0 is not a legal settledAt, so absent, null and 0 all read as missing (unlike amount and version).

cases.name: settle-create-settled-at-seconds
cases.note: A seconds-scale timestamp is below the 1e12 ms floor.

cases.name: settle-create-settled-at-past-24h-ahead
cases.note: 10 s beyond the 24 h ceiling, so the SDK's later clock still refuses it.

cases.name: settle-create-order-amount-absent-before-currency
cases.note: Without absence the amount is 0, which is legal, so the currency is the first fault.

cases.name: settle-create-order-version-absent-before-xsettle
cases.note: Without absence the version is 0, which is legal, so xSettle is the first fault.

cases.name: settle-keystore-private-key-left-out
cases.note: A served partner without a private key is invalid_private_key; an unserved one is unknown_partner.

cases.name: settle-keystore-exact-partner-match
cases.note: Partner ids are matched byte for byte: no case folding, no trimming.

cases.name: settle-client-accepted
cases.note: One POST with Content-Type application/json and a body whose only member is settlementJWT.

cases.name: settle-client-accepted-member-nested-64-levels
cases.note: The answer nests 64 levels deep: the body object, then 63 arrays in the ignored member x.

cases.name: settle-client-accepted-escaped-member-names
cases.note: Member names are compared after JSON unescaping.

cases.name: settle-client-accepted-case-variant-ignored
cases.note: A member spelled in another case is unknown and overrides nothing.

cases.name: settle-client-unexpected-error-only
cases.note: A 2xx is never read for an error member: its text is always 'unexpected response'.

cases.name: settle-client-unexpected-byte-order-mark
cases.note: The capped bytes begin with EF BB BF, so they are not JSON for the SDK.

cases.name: settle-client-unexpected-204-no-content
cases.note: A 204 has no body; a fake transport answers it with a null body.

cases.name: settle-client-accepted-padded-to-cap
cases.note: 65536 bytes, whitespace inserted before the final brace: all of it is read.

cases.name: settle-client-unexpected-acceptance-cut-by-cap
cases.note: One byte over the cap: the final brace is beyond the first 65536 bytes.

cases.name: settle-client-accepted-bytes-beyond-cap-ignored
cases.note: Byte 65537 is 0xFF and is discarded unread, so the capped bytes are a valid acceptance.

cases.name: settle-client-unexpected-garbage-at-cap
cases.note: Byte 65536, the last one read, is 'x' after the acceptance.

cases.name: settle-client-redirect-301-not-followed
cases.note: A redirect is an API error with its own status; the SDK sends one request and follows nothing.

cases.name: settle-client-base-url-default
cases.note: A null base URL selects the production default.

cases.name: settle-client-base-url-endpoint-url-trailing-slash
cases.note: Trailing slashes go first, then the endpoint path.

cases.name: settle-client-base-url-slash-before-endpoint-kept
cases.note: Only the endpoint path is removed; the slash before it stays.

cases.name: settle-client-base-url-query-concatenated
cases.note: Plain string concatenation: the endpoint path lands after the query.

cases.name: settle-client-base-url-scheme-case-insensitive
cases.note: The scheme is compared ignoring ASCII case. The URL a transport records may lowercase it, so it is not compared.

cases.name: settle-client-base-url-ascii-whitespace-trimmed
cases.note: Exactly U+0009-U+000D and U+0020 are trimmed, before the slashes.

cases.name: settle-client-base-url-empty
cases.note: An empty base URL is refused, never replaced by the default.

cases.name: settle-client-base-url-single-slash
cases.note: The literal prefix http:// or https:// is required; no parser repair applies.

cases.name: settle-client-no-key-store
cases.note: keyStore null: no store at all (JS null, Go nil), refused when the client is built.

cases.name: settle-client-store-plain-error-passes-through
cases.note: An error from outside the SDK carries no taxonomy category and reaches the caller unchanged.

cases.name: settle-client-timeout-reading-body
cases.note: The limit runs through reading the capped body.

cases.name: settle-client-timeout-in-key-lookup
cases.note: The limit starts before the key store lookup.

cases.name: settle-client-timeout-spans-whole-attempt
cases.note: Each wait is under the limit, their sum is not: one limit covers the whole attempt.

cases.name: settle-client-timeout-zero-means-default
cases.note: 0 means the 30 s default, not an immediate expiry.

cases.name: settle-client-cancelled-before-call-unknown-partner
cases.note: An already cancelled handle fails before the key store is consulted.

cases.name: settle-client-null-cancel-handle
cases.note: cancel null: the handle itself is null (JS {signal: null}, Go a nil context), which means no cancellation.
